summary: Bail rejection review; predicate offence (PC Act) vs. money laundering case; arrest timing discrepancy (5 years post-ECIR); cooperation via summons under s.50 PMLA; disproportionate assets calculation dispute (Rs.1.63cr vs Rs.4.81cr); accommodation entries through shell companies (Rs.4.61cr) for tax evasion under IDS 2016; corporate veil shielding; bail granted by interim medical relief; proviso to s.45 PMLA threshold (1cr) analysis; alleged shareholder liability for company assets; medical grounds bail extension.

PMLA s.3, s.4, s.45 proviso, s.50
